- Decision criteria: latency SLA, data handling (PII), and predictable unit economics.
- Timeline: target pilot kickoff in August.

- Procurement/legal: Acme procurement/Legal (procure@acmeanalytics.com) - owns NDA/MSA routing and PO

1) Who should we route the NDA to first? Is procurement or legal the right first touch?
2) Typical turn times for: NDA, MSA redlines, DPA?
3) Preferred execution method (DocuSign) and do you require counterparty-specific MSA clauses?

- If NDA OK, we can execute NDA and have Redwood legal start MSA redline sequencing (we typically do NDA -> MSA -> DPA).
- I'll loop in our legal/SE: Dev Patel (legal lead on this) and Rishi for coordination.

Thanks - I'll follow up Thursday if I haven't heard back.

- Procurement lead (PO/contract routing): Elaine Park <procure@acmeanalytics.com> (cc'd).
- Legal review (MSA/DPA): our legal team will pick up once procurement has an executed NDA.

Turn times (typical):
- NDA (standard): 1-2 business days after receipt if no bespoke clauses.
- MSA: initial redline 7-10 business days (depends on complexity).
- DPA: 3-5 business days (assuming standard clauses).

Sequence preference: NDA first, then MSA/DPA in parallel where possible. We prefer DocuSign for execution.
